items.headline: FDA approves first new kidney treatment in decades for adults with type one diabetes
items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration approved finerenone for adults with chronic kidney disease linked to type one diabetes, based on a trial showing it cut a key marker of kidney damage by more than a quarter within six months. It is the first new treatment option for this group of patients in more than thirty years.
items.why_it_matters: Up to a third of adults with type one diabetes develop chronic kidney disease, and this pill gives them a treatment option that did not exist before.
